insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options by plan as per Annexure C (e.g., Optima Secure: 5/10/15/20/25/50/100/200 Lakhs per Insured Person per Policy Year; other plans differ). Total Sum Insured is aggregate of Base Sum Insured + (if applicable) Cumulative Bonus/Plus Benefit + Secure Benefit + Automatic Restore Benefit (as per definition).

great.name: Room rent at actuals by default (unless restricted in Policy Schedule/plan)
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: If your schedule/plan keeps room rent at actuals, there is no room-category cap (best-in-class vs %SI caps).

great.name: ICU charges at actuals by default (unless restricted in Policy Schedule/plan)
great.quote: ICU limit (including ICCU) for bed charges shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Avoids ICU sub-limits unless your schedule/plan specifies otherwise.

great.name: Automatic Restore can be unlimited times if specified in schedule (instant 100% base SI restore)
great.quote: In case ‘Unlimited Times’ is specified against this benefit in the Policy Schedule it shall mean that this benefit shall trigger every time an admissible claim is paid during the Policy Year.
great.reference: Page 17 | Section B.2.6(i) Automatic Restore Benefit
great.explanation: High-value feature: enables repeated restoration within a policy year when schedule provides 'Unlimited Times'.

great.name: Restore usable for same illness as well (and by any member in floater)
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.reference: Page 18 | Section B.2.6(vi) Automatic Restore Benefit
great.explanation: Many policies restrict restores to unrelated illnesses; this allows same illness reuse.

great.name: Plus Benefit: 50% of Base SI added on renewal, irrespective of claims (accumulates up to 100%)
great.quote: On Renewal... a sum equal to 50% of the Base Sum Insured under the expiring Policy will be added... This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.explanation: Strong renewal bonus even if claims occurred (where Plus Benefit is in force).

great.name: Secure Benefit: additional SI available (after base exhaust), usable for multiple claims (once per policy year)
great.quote: An additional amount as specified in the Policy Schedule will be available... The Secure Benefit can be utilized for any number of claims admissible under the Policy during the Policy Year... The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: A top-up-like additional cover layer (plan/schedule dependent) that can fund multiple claims after base SI is used.

great.name: Home Health Care (cashless-only) available when pre-authorized (home treatment cover)
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses... on availing treatment at Home... The treatment is pre-authorized... This Cover is not available on reimbursement basis.
great.reference: Page 12 | Section B.1.2 Home Health Care
great.explanation: Dedicated home treatment benefit (subject to pre-auth), can be valuable for post-acute care at home.

great.name: Organ donor hospitalization expenses covered (for harvesting) when insured is recipient
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify... towards the organ donor’s Hospitalization for harvesting of the donated organ where an Insured Person is the recipient
great.reference: Page 13 | Section B.1.7 Organ Donor Expenses
great.explanation: Covers donor hospitalization costs (harvesting) which are otherwise often excluded.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization up to 60 days and post-hospitalization up to 180 days (unless schedule modifies)
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule... Post... indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule
great.explanation: Long post-hospital coverage (180 days) and good pre-hospital window (60 days), subject to plan/schedule changes (e.g., Optima Lite).

great.name: Daily cash benefit when choosing shared room in network hospital (after 48 hours hospitalization)
great.quote: pay a daily cash amount... for each continuous and completed 24 hours... if... Hospitalised in shared accommodation in a Network Provider Hospital and such Hospitalization exceeds 48 consecutive hours.
great.reference: Page 15 | Section B.2.2 Daily Cash for Shared Room
great.explanation: Fixed cash benefit can offset incidental expenses when opting shared room (must be network + >48 hours).

great.name: Premium tier has no co-pay for Tier 2 customer treated in Tier 1 city
great.quote: No co-payment shall apply if Insured Person from Tier 2 avails a treatment in Tier 1.
great.explanation: Important: city-tier pricing doesn't introduce a treatment-location co-pay penalty.

great.name: Moratorium after 60 continuous months: insurer cannot contest for non-disclosure/misrepresentation except fraud (for original SI; enhanced SI has its own 60 months)
great.quote: After completion of sixty continuous months of coverage... no policy and claim shall be contestable... except on grounds of established fraud... Wherever, the sum insured is enhanced... applicable from the date of enhancement... on the enhanced limits.
great.explanation: Strong long-term protection against repudiation once moratorium is completed.

great.name: Multiple policies: can claim disallowed amounts from other insurer even if SI not exhausted
great.quote: Insured Person... shall also have the right to prefer claims under this Policy for the amounts disallowed under any other policy / policies even if the Sum Insured is not exhausted.
great.explanation: Facilitates secondary claims for non-payable items under another insurer, subject to this policy terms.

great.name: Global plans: worldwide coverage for emergency/planned (optional covers) with RBI exchange rate mechanism
great.quote: Global Health Cover... benefits shall be extended for both planned and Emergency Medical Expenses outside India... payment... based on the rate of exchange... published by Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
great.reference: Page 22-23 | Section B.2.10 Global Health Cover (Emergency & Planned Treatments)
great.explanation: Useful for overseas treatment for Global Plus plan; clearly defines FX conversion basis.

good.name: 30-day initial waiting period (standard) with exception for accidents
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard initial waiting period; not zero, but common in indemnity policies.

good.name: Specified disease/procedure waiting period is 24 months (except accidents)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage... This exclusion shall not be applicable for claims arising due to an Accident.
good.reference: Page 28 | Section C.1(b) Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period (Excl02)
good.explanation: 2-year specific waiting period is typical; note the long list of conditions and procedures.

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period is 36 months by default; can be modified to 12/24 months via option (channel-level at inception)
good.quote: Pre-Existing Diseases... excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule)...
good.explanation: PED wait is 36 months (not best-in-class), but there is an optional modification to 12/24 months if schedule allows.

good.name: PED waiting period reduction option (12 or 24 months) exists, but only selectable at channel level at inception
good.quote: Pre-existing Disease Waiting Period shall stand modified... options... to 24 months... to 12 months... This optional cover is allowed to be opted at channel level only and only at the time of policy inception. Policyholders will therefore not be able to opt for the same.
good.reference: Page 25 | Section B.2.12 PED waiting period modification
good.explanation: Can materially improve PED wait, but the customer cannot later choose it; depends on distribution channel setup and schedule.

good.name: AYUSH inpatient covered up to sub-limit in schedule
good.quote: shall indemnify... only for Inpatient Care under Ayurveda... during each Policy Year up to the Sub-limit specified... in any AYUSH Hospital.
good.explanation: Inpatient AYUSH available but subject to a schedule sub-limit.

good.name: Emergency air ambulance optional cover with SI-capped limit but does not reduce base SI
good.quote: The amount specified in the Policy schedule against this benefit denotes the Company's maximum liability... and shall not reduce the Sum Insured of the policy.
good.reference: Page 15 | Section B.2.1(g) Emergency Air Ambulance
good.explanation: Separate cap for air ambulance; helpful and doesn't eat into base SI for this benefit.

good.name: Dental (inpatient) covered when necessitated due to disease/injury
good.quote: In patient Care Dental Treatment, necessitated due to disease or Injury
good.explanation: Inpatient dental is covered (not OPD dental), which is better than many base policies.

good.name: Plastic surgery covered when necessitated due to injury
good.quote: Plastic Surgery, necessitated due to Injury
good.explanation: Covers reconstructive plastic surgery after injury under hospitalization.

good.name: Cumulative Bonus for certain plans (10% or 25% per year up to 100%) irrespective of claims
good.quote: a sum equal to 10%... of the Base Sum Insured... shall be provided as CB irrespective of any claims
good.explanation: CB exists for some plans only; Annexure C shows plan-specific availability and rates.

good.name: Preventive health check-up renewal benefit (amounts based on base SI; does not reduce SI)
good.quote: On completion of each Policy Year... indemnify the cost of a Preventive Health Check-up... The amount specified... shall not reduce the Sum Insured of the policy.
good.reference: Page 27 | Section B.3 Renewal Benefit - Preventive Health Check-up
good.explanation: Annual preventive benefit after first year, subject to schedule and deductible restrictions.

good.name: Claim settlement timeline with penal interest (2% above bank rate for delay)
good.quote: settle or reject... within 15 days... In the case of delay... pay interest... at a rate 2% above the bank rate.
good.reference: Page 33 | Section D.1.3 Claim Settlement (provision for Penal Interest)
good.explanation: Defines timelines and compensation if insurer delays beyond prescribed period.

good.name: Free look period of 30 days for new individual policies
good.quote: free look period of thirty days from date of receipt of the policy document
good.reference: Page 35 | Section D.1.8 Free look Period
good.explanation: Allows cancellation/refund (with deductions) if terms not acceptable.

good.name: Optional cover: Protect Benefit covers listed non-medical expenses (Annexure B) for admissible claims
good.quote: indemnify... for the Non-Medical Expenses listed under Annexure B... incurred in relation to a claim admissible under Section B-1 (Base Coverage)
good.explanation: Unusual: explicit non-medical expense coverage if Protect Benefit is in force.

bad.name: PED waiting period is 36 months by default (long)
bad.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage
bad.explanation: 36 months is relatively long versus best-in-class 12 months.

bad.name: Room rent can trigger proportionate deductions on associated medical expenses if higher than eligibility
bad.quote: if... admitted in a room that exceeds the category/limit... reimbursement... including all Associated Medical Expenses... shall be effected in the same proportion as the admissible rate per day bears to the actual rate per day
bad.reference: Page 12 | Section B.1.1(iii) Proportionate deduction on Room Rent
bad.explanation: Classic room-rent-linked proportionate deduction risk if you choose above-eligible room category.

bad.name: Home Health Care is not available on reimbursement basis
bad.quote: This Cover is not available on reimbursement basis.
bad.reference: Page 12 | Section B.1.2 Home Health Care
bad.explanation: If cashless/pre-auth is not obtained, you may be unable to claim home healthcare expenses.

bad.name: Global emergency cover excludes oncology and most orthopedic conditions (except fractures/dislocations/injuries)
bad.quote: Specific Exclusions... Oncological (Cancer) diseases... Any treatment of orthopedic diseases or conditions except for fractures, dislocations and / or Injuries suffered during the Policy Period.
bad.reference: Page 22 | Section B.2.9(B)(v) & (vi) Global Health Cover (Emergency Treatments Only)
bad.explanation: Major limitation for overseas emergency cover: cancer not covered; orthopedic limited.

bad.name: Global emergency cover: treatment must commence within first 45 days of a trip
bad.quote: We would not be liable to pay any claim wherein the medical treatment taken outside India has not commenced within the first 45 days of a trip.
bad.reference: Page 21 | Section B.2.9(A)(vi) Global Health Cover (Emergency Treatments Only)
bad.explanation: Time-bound restriction on overseas emergency claims based on trip duration.

bad.name: Global covers impose per-claim deductible of Rs. 10,000 (outside India) even though aggregate deductible not applicable
bad.quote: Aggregate Deductible will not be applicable... However, a Per Claim Deductible of Rs. 10,000 will apply separately for each and every claim
bad.reference: Page 21 | Section B.2.9(A)(ii) Global Health Cover (Emergency Treatments Only)
bad.explanation: Out-of-India claims have a fixed per-claim deductible which increases out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Non-medical expenses are excluded by default (long list in Annexure B)
bad.quote: Non-Medical expenses such as food charges... laundry charges... attendant charges... Full list of Non-Medical Expenses is attached as ANNEXURE B
bad.explanation: Common but impactful: many hospital bill items are excluded unless Protect Benefit is opted.

bad.name: OPD treatment excluded
bad.explanation: No OPD coverage under base policy (unless an add-on like Optima Wellbeing is separately purchased).

bad.name: Maternity excluded (except ectopic pregnancy); miscarriage/termination excluded unless due to accident
bad.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth... except ectopic pregnancy; Expenses towards miscarriage (unless due to an accident) and lawful medical termination of pregnancy
bad.explanation: Base policy does not cover maternity-related hospitalization (except ectopic).

bad.name: Congenital external anomalies excluded
bad.quote: Congenital external diseases, defects or anomalies.
bad.explanation: External congenital conditions are excluded (internal congenital not explicitly listed here, but may be handled under standard definitions/other exclusions).

bad.name: Refractive error < 7.5 dioptres excluded
bad.quote: Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.
bad.explanation: Vision correction is excluded unless refractive error is 7.5D or more (and even then subject to policy terms).

bad.name: Excluded providers: if hospital/doctor is on insurer's excluded list, only stabilization covered for life-threatening/accident, not full claim
bad.quote: Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner... specifically excluded... are not admissible. However, in case of Life Threatening Situations or following an Accident, expenses up to the stage of stabilization are payable but not the complete claim.
bad.explanation: Significant risk: treatment at excluded providers can lead to denial except limited stabilization costs.

bad.name: Aggregate deductible option can remove key benefits at higher deductible levels (>=10L), and even preventive check-up at 5L deductible
bad.quote: Preventive Health Check -up benefit will not be available... if Aggregate Deductible of INR 5 Lakhs is in force... Secure Benefit, Cumulative Bonus / Plus Benefit, Automatic Restore Benefit, Daily Cash for Shared Room and Unlimited Restore... will not be available... if Aggregate Deductible of INR 10 Lakhs or more is in force.
bad.explanation: Choosing a high aggregate deductible materially reduces valuable benefits; important for buyers of deductible variants.

bad.name: If non-disclosure/misrepresentation of PED detected, insurer can permanently exclude condition / add waiting period up to 3 years / levy loading (with consent)
bad.quote: exercise... options... Permanently exclude... Incorporate additional Waiting Period of not exceeding 3 years... Levy underwriting loading
bad.reference: Page 39 | Section D.1.18 Non-Disclosure or Misrepresentation of Pre-Existing Disease
bad.explanation: Post-issuance adverse actions are possible if PED non-disclosure is found.

unclear.name: Policy type (Individual vs Family Floater) depends on Policy Schedule; wording supports both
unclear.quote: Sum Insured (Individual or Floater)... specified in the Policy Schedule.
unclear.explanation: Document supports individual and floater structures, but the actual type for a customer is determined by the Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Room rent/ICU limits and sub-limits depend on Policy Schedule and selected plan options
unclear.quote: Room rent limit shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule... ICU limit... shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
unclear.explanation: Without the specific policy schedule/plan selection, it is unclear whether the insured has 'At Actuals' or capped room rent/ICU (e.g., Optima Lite %SI, Optima Select single private).

unclear.name: Protect Benefit availability varies by plan (inbuilt/optional/not covered)
unclear.quote: The Covers listed below are optional covers... applicable... only if it is specified in the Policy Schedule to be in force... Note: Please refer to ‘Annexure C’ for details pertaining to optional covers available with your plan opted
unclear.explanation: Feature exists but may be inbuilt/optional/not available depending on plan and what is shown in the policy schedule.

unclear.name: Cumulative Bonus applicability is plan-dependent; Annexure shows 'Not Covered' for some plans
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonus (CB) [Applicable to ‘Optima Suraksha’, ‘Optima Lite’ and ‘Optima Select’ plans]
unclear.explanation: For Optima Secure plan specifically, Annexure C indicates CB may be not covered; exact applicability must be verified in Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Emergency Air Ambulance / Daily Cash amounts depend on schedule; Annexure provides sample plan chart values
unclear.quote: The Company shall pay a daily cash amount as specified in Policy Schedule...
unclear.reference: Page 15 | Section B.2.2 Daily Cash for Shared Room
unclear.explanation: Without the Policy Schedule, the exact per-day cash and max cap applicable cannot be confirmed.
